basic_profile.bio: I'm a 30-year-old graphic designer based in Portland, Oregon. I've been on Reddit for over seven years, mostly lurking but occasionally diving into discussions that pique my interest. I'm a cannabis enthusiast and enjoy exploring different strains and methods of consumption. When I'm not working on design projects or browsing Reddit, you can find me hiking the trails at nearby national parks or experimenting with new recipes in the kitchen. I'm currently single and enjoy the freedom to travel and explore new places. My typical online hours are late evenings, after winding down from a busy day.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design from an art school in California. My knowledge of cannabis comes from years of personal use and self-education, including reading up on the latest research and trends. I also have a keen interest in photography, which I picked up through online tutorials and practice.
behavioral_pattern.relationship_with_community_policies: I am highly familiar with community guidelines and site-wide rules. I typically adhere to them strictly to maintain a positive standing and ensure constructive discussions.
